content:
incident-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx and quota exhaustion detected on /v1/embeddings (region-us-west). spike began ~2112233420. auto-scaling failing to keep up.

alice-oncall: acknowledging. paging ben and david. grabbing quick scope: are chats affected or just embeddings?

ben-sre: I'm on it. seeing sustained 500s from embeddings-hot-route and downstream backlog in rpc-proxy. chat endpoints showing increased latency but low 5xx — looks like embeddings traffic is starving shared pools (same hardware pool for small models).

david-eng: confirmed. partner-heavy traffic burst targeting /v1/embeddings/semantic-batch with huge batch size. quota counters for embeddings routes hit hard, causing eviction of KV caches and OOM retries.

alice-oncall: immediate mitigation options: (A) tighten per-route quotas for offending partner route, (B) raise dedicated quota for chat routes, (C) disable rerank (high cost) temporarily, (D) enable stricter rate-limiter shards for embeddings. propose we do A + C now to preserve chat. any objections? :thinking_face:

carla-pm: prioritize customer-facing chat (SLAs), agree with A + C. we need messaging for impacted customers if rerank disabled. emma, can support draft communications?

emma-support: on it. will prepare short note: "We are temporarily disabling rerank for certain traffic to stabilize response quality and latency. No data loss. We'll update in 1h."

ben-sre: executing quota clamp now. running internal admin commands.

ben-sre: ```
# clamp partner route to 40 qps
ri-admin routes update --route-id partner-x/embeddings --max-qps 40 --reason "live-mitigation: protect chat"
# decrease rerank concurrency across region
ri-admin feature toggle set rerank --region us-west --state disabled --note "live mitigation 211223"
```

incident-bot: ACTION LOG: route update submitted by ben-sre at 2112233452. rerank toggle requested at 2112233453.

alice-oncall: applying targeted per-endpoint quota for embeddings group to avoid collateral impact. also creating route-shape: chat-priority -> reserve 30% capacity, embeddings-low -> burst-limited.

david-eng: applied traffic-shaping policy: 
```
PATCH /admin/routes/shaping
{
  "region":"us-west",
  "shapes":[{"route":"/v1/chat","min_reserve_pct":30},{"route":"/v1/embeddings","max_qps":120}]
}
```

ben-sre: telemetry update: embeddings 5xx dropped from 9.4% -> 0.8% within 60s of clamp. chat p50 latency stabilized. rerank disabled: requests for rerank now return 503 with guidance header.

alice-oncall: customer impact: approx 8 paying customers experienced degraded embeddings throughput; 3 customers had jobs retried/cancelled. no broad chat outages. immediate ask: support to contact the 3 impacted customers with mitigation steps and ETA. carla, we should log this as a Severity 2 incident.

carla-pm: agreed S2. logging incident ticket and scheduling 30-min follow-up with engineering + product after stabilization.

emma-support: outreach messages drafted for the three customers. linking in #support-private.

ben-sre: monitoring - keeping clamps in place for now. rolling window check for 15m. if stable, we'll incrementally relax embeddings max-qps to avoid re-trigger.

alice-oncall: handoff plan: I'll remain on lead for next 20m and then hand to ben for overnight watch. ben, you'll own rollback plan and post-incident notes.

ben-sre: ACK. rollback plan: 1) gradually increase partner-x embeddings max-qps by +10 qps every 5m while watching 5xx and queue depth; 2) re-enable rerank for region once 5xx < 1% for 10m.

incident-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT @2112233470: embeddings 5xx=0.9% (was 9.4%), ingress qps embeddings=520->260 after clamp, chat p95 latency down 18%.

alice-oncall: resolution criteria met for now. keeping thread open until rerank re-enable. next steps: postmortem, recommend: per-route burst caps by default on partner routes, better batch-size admission control at proxy, and alerting for shared-pool exhaustion.

carla-pm: noted. will add to action items: quota policy changes, partner onboarding docs update, and product-level guardrails for rerank heavy jobs.

ben-sre: leaving monitoring in alarm mode. will update thread on rollback progress. handing lead to ben-sre at 2112233478. :white_check_mark:

alice-oncall: thanks team. closing live mitigation phase.
